description: NaMgTi₃O₇F crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.49 Å. Mg is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.21 Å. Both Mg-F bond lengths are 1.97 Å. There are three inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O and one F atom to form distorted corner-sharing TiO₄F trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.95 Å. The Ti-F bond length is 2.05 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.02 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.20 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Ti atoms to form corner-sharing ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Ti atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Ti atom. F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Mg and one Ti atom.
